name: Screams Echo
summary:
Dive into the chaos of an abandoned underground complex, where biological experiments have gone terribly wrong, spawning hordes of mutants and monstrosities.

Screams Echo blends the fast-paced gameplay of Vampire Survivors with the roguelite mechanics of The Binding of Isaac, offering endless build possibilities, hundreds of items, and weapons to create unique survival strategies.

Choose from a diverse cast of heroes, each with their own unique abilities, and descend into the depths as unexpected story twists unfold. Explore procedurally generated levels, fight massive waves of enemies in real time, and adapt to constantly changing conditions.
